query:
SELECT content->'m.relates_to'->>'event_id' AS "root!",
                   MAX(stream_position) AS "latest!",
                   BOOL_OR(sender = $2) AS "participated!"
            FROM events
            WHERE room_id = $1
              AND content->'m.relates_to'->>'rel_type' = 'm.thread'
              AND content->'m.relates_to'->>'event_id' IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY 1
            ORDER BY 2 DESC
